sources.name: Crime in England and Wales Quality and Methodology Information
sources.observed_evidence: The QMI distinguishes the Crime Survey for England and Wales from police recorded crime, identifies recording-quality limitations and states that police recorded crime excludes non-notifiable offences.
sources.semantic_limit: Methodology and misuse-prevention guard only; it contains no parcel-level incident record and creates no score.

sources.name: Home Office Crime Recording Rules for frontline officers and staff
sources.observed_evidence: The national crime recording standard page was last updated on 16 July 2026 and records recent 2026 rule and outcomes-framework changes.
sources.semantic_limit: Recording and counting-rule validation only; rule changes must not be interpreted as local risk changes or direct parcel evidence.

sources.name: Police recorded crime and outcomes National Data Library collection
sources.observed_evidence: The official collection enumerates PFA, CSP, knife, firearm, hate-crime, rape, outcomes, transferred-or-cancelled and fraud datasets.
sources.semantic_limit: Dataset discovery and coverage reconciliation only; catalogue membership does not prove row freshness, completeness or parcel attribution.

sources.name: Crime outcomes in England and Wales technical annex
sources.observed_evidence: The technical annex documents the outcomes framework, definitions, timeliness, transferred or cancelled records and data-quality limitations.
sources.semantic_limit: Outcome-methodology QA only; outcome status is not a direct parcel safety signal and cannot repair missing territorial coverage.

sources.name: Criminal Justice Statistics Quarterly December 2025
sources.observed_evidence: The accredited official statistics cover prosecutions, convictions, remand and sentencing and include a recorded data-tool correction dated 29 June 2026.
sources.semantic_limit: National downstream justice-system context only; court outcomes are delayed, selective and unsuitable for direct neighbourhood or parcel scoring.

sources.name: Criminal court statistics quarterly January to March 2026 and quality guide
sources.observed_evidence: The accredited quarterly publication and guide cover court case volumes, progression, timeliness, definitions and data-quality principles.
sources.semantic_limit: Court-flow and system-capacity context only; it is not incident-location evidence and must remain outside parcel scoring.
